cls: This needs to be done through Stop(), but I don't think you want to do that until you're sure the new stream will create/connect?
This code has vastly different behavior on `Android R-` and `Android S+`. Could you double check that your patch still works on older version of Android?
Tiny nit: `const bool` in both locations.
Throwing an error will result in the stream being stopped, but probably this should just call Stop() outside the lock. Defer to Thomas.
I don't know how often we have more than one stream in `input_streams_requiring_sco_`, but if there is more than one, this won't stop SCO at all. I don't know if this really is an issue, just…
Might be worth scoping the lock to avoid calling into audio_manager_ holding it. Seems safe now, but maybe not later.
